span_inventory.text: Thanks for your patience about item R-72.

payload.unknown_convention: UNKNOWN for uncertain strings; null for uncertain explicit causality
payload.entity_convention: entity_refs must be exact strings explicitly present in response; do not invent IDs
payload.task_instructions: Identify a short predicate/action/state; preserve whether the span claims archive as an action or archived as a state. UNKNOWN is allowed. Do not invent a tool identity from a verb.
payload.task_scope: Interpret only this field/pass. Keep actor, intent, observed state and causality distinct.
